title: Aristotle, Poetics (Project Gutenberg)
summary: Plot as the arrangement of incidents in which each event follows from what precedes it, with reversal and recognition as changes of situation. Motivates SL01 and SL06 as tests of whether a scene changes anything and whether a planted element is used.

title: Wikipedia: Story structure
summary: Summarizes structural frameworks in which scenes advance a causal chain toward resolution. Motivates SL01 and SL08; an encyclopedic overview, not craft authority.

title: Wikipedia: Narration
summary: Describes narrative point of view, including limited viewpoints restricted to what one character knows, and narrator reliability. Motivates SL02, SL03, SL08.

title: Wikipedia: Show, don't tell
summary: Describes the advice to convey emotion through action and sensation rather than exposition, together with its critics. Motivates SL04, SL05, SL07 as classifications, not rules.

title: Wikipedia: Chekhov's gun
summary: Describes the principle that a detail introduced in a story should be used later. Motivates SL06 and SL08.
